title: Hearing a question and answering together
meaning: Exploring uncertain meaning can inspire you when careful attention brings the pleasure of recognising something worth responding to together.
text: A shared direction does not always arrive in clear words. The Moon in the energy of Sahasrara supports gentle exploration of uncertainty: noticing an inner image, distinguishing impressions from what is known and allowing time before a final explanation. The High Priestess in the physical position appears through attentive listening and study of what remains between the lines. Judgement in emotions brings the uplift of recognition. Something important seems to address you, and feeling ready to answer together is rewarding. An unclear beginning can reveal a purpose that invites participation beyond your relationship.

For example, at a meeting about the future of a neighbourhood space, you hear several brief accounts of loneliness. Instead of explaining people’s wishes for them, you notice a recurring question about somewhere to meet. **Meaning feels close when you recognise a possible shared response within it.** Offering help with the first open evening brings a lift: attentive listening now has a continuation directed towards the people whose voices you heard together.

The difficulty may arise if your inward reading becomes the only basis for action. A few hints form an appealing interpretation, but nobody has asked the people involved a clarifying question. Gentle regard for uncertainty and the pleasure of responding remain supportive. Attention becomes more useful when it allows a simple check of whether you understood the need expressed at this particular meeting.
